description.en: Six coloured actions arrive from the outside in clockwise order, spring into a ring, then scatter outwards in reverse with soft blur.
description.zh: 六个彩色按钮从外围顺时针依次收拢成环，弹性停稳；关闭时逆序向外散开并模糊淡出。

keywords: 环形 菜单 交错 展开 圆形 按钮 加号 模糊 错峰 弹簧 stagger radial menu clockwise blur spring

discovery.caveat: 适合少量快捷操作，接入时替换演示动作。

source.implementation: Independent DOM/CSS/SVG reconstruction; no original author source or vector files obtained.
source.license: Original design license not verified; attribution does not grant redistribution rights to original assets.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click + to open the actions and × to scatter them outwards. Touch and keyboard work too; choosing an action only updates this local demonstration.
instructions.zh: 点击 + 展开，点击 × 向外散开收起。支持触屏和键盘，选择菜单项仅更新本地演示状态。
